note: Rendering and delivery constants for the market-outlook brief (FABLE-OUTLOOK-METHODOLOGY-LQ-946 WU-3, sections 4.3/4.7). Numbers only: the advisory sentence is never assembled from a template that names an order. Text length comes from config/critical_text_classes.json (class market_outlook, max_chars 300 per D1), never from this file.
telegram_note: A sanity bound against a runaway render, not a delivery limit: the raw Telegram sender splits at its own 4096-character limit and sends the ordered chunks, so the Sunday brief (outlook plus the folded Monday plan, about 15k) arrives as a few ordered parts of ONE lane send with ONE receipt. The cap is refused, never truncated.

action_short_by_band.RISK-ON: all tranches eligible, keep the 5% reserve
action_short_by_band.NEUTRAL: first tranche only, hold the 5% reserve
action_short_by_band.DEFENSIVE: no new tranches, hold the 5% reserve

__public_repo_note: No address, phone number, account id or holding lives here or in the renderers: the text channel resolves the operator's Fi lines from persistent-state operator_contact.json (scripts/lib/critical_texts.py), and email resolves its target from the delivery module.
